channel.title: The Grant Desk - AI, Tech & Research, NL, weekly digest
channel.description: Paid open calls, fellowships and residencies in AI, tech, research, and digital and mixed-media arts, sorted into the right pile. Updated as new calls land on the desk. Filtered to: AI, Tech & Research, NL, weekly digest. One entry per week rounding up everything released that week, instead of one entry per grant.

item.title: 4 new grants - week of 24 Aug 2026
item.description:
4 new grants landed on The Grant Desk in the week of 24 Aug 2026 (24 Aug to 30 Aug 2026).

  • University of Twente: Postdoc, Ethics and Epistemology of LLMs4EU (17 months)
    University of Twente, Philosophy section / 4TU.Center for Ethics and Technology · deadline Closed 25 Aug 2026 · EUR 4,241 to 5,538 gross per month (scale 10, steps 4 to 12) at 1.0 FTE, plus 8 percent holiday allowance and an 8.3 percent year-end bonus.
  • Human Rights Watch: AI Strategy and Solutions Lead (one-year fixed term)
    Human Rights Watch (HRW), Operations Department · deadline 30 Aug 2026 · USD 102,000 to 112,000 plus employer-paid benefits if based in the US; ranges outside the US are set by local market conditions. No application fee.
  • Fonds BJP: Dossiersubsidie for Freelance Regional and Local Journalists (autumn 2026 round)
    Fonds Bijzondere Journalistieke Projecten (Fonds BJP) · deadline 14 Sep 2026 · Up to EUR 19,200 for six months of work on a single reporting dossier. No application fee.
  • Trust me, I'm an AI/rtist: Open Call for Creative Interventions
    Waag Futurelab (Horizon Europe project HAMLET) · deadline 30 Sep 2026 · EUR 20,000 commission fee excluding VAT, inclusive of artist fee, travel, accommodation and production costs. Applicants must have a VAT number in Europe. No...
